excuse_me.note: polite phrase to get attention or apologize for a small inte

good_afternoon.note: greeting used from noon until evening

good_night.note: farewell said before sleeping or leaving at night

have_a_nice_day.note: polite farewell wishing someone a pleasant day

how_are_you.note: polite question asking about someone's well-being

nice_to_meet_you.note: polite phrase said when meeting someone for the first time

please.note: polite word used when making a request

see_you_later.note: friendly farewell when expecting to meet again

take_care.note: kind farewell wishing someone safety and well-being

you_are_welcome.note: polite reply when someone says thank you
